primary_analysis: Compute the paired success-rate difference (guarded minus baseline) on the completed paired episodes (completed_episode_count/2 = 166/2 = 83 paired tasks) using the preregistered held-out test indices where both condition episodes exist. For each paired task produce binary outcomes (success=judge labels assertion as 'supported', failure='unsupported') from execution/responses and execution/scoring JSONs; compute the proportion-success per condition, the absolute difference (guarded − baseline), and a 95% bootstrap CI (1000 stratified resamples by class) for the difference. Assess paired significance with McNemar's test (alpha=0.05) on the paired binary outcomes. Report confusion matrices and exact paired counts (both/discordant) computed from execution/scoring/*.json.
secondary_analyses: Precision and recall for each condition (supported and unsupported classes) with 95% bootstrap CIs (1000 stratified resamples) computed from executed scoring artifacts.
Paired discordant-count comparison (guarded vs baseline) reported with McNemar's test p-value and exact counts.
Calibration assessment: Brier score and calibration curve for judge confidence scores derived from execution/scoring JSONs (plot and calibration table).

Ablation series removing each deterministic signal (retrieval evidence disabled, telemetry features removed, validator outputs removed) re-trained and evaluated on identical splits/seeds; report effect sizes and 95% CIs for the paired success-rate difference for each ablation (FDR-controlled for exploratory tests).
sensitivity_analyses: Primary-analysis population restricted to uncontaminated samples if any index-hash mismatch flags are present (per preregistered contamination_plan) and report differences vs main analysis.
Impute missing retrieval evidence as zero for affected samples and re-run primary analysis.

Alternative failed-call handling: treat incomplete or failed episodes per sensitivity contract complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (i.e., complete pairs by counting failed episode as failure/zero) and re-run primary analysis; report effect and CI.
Simulate reduced unsupported-class prevalence (per preregistration) to assess robustness of success-rate difference estimates.
uncertainty_quantification: 95% bootstrap confidence intervals with 1000 resamples stratified by class for proportions and differences; paired McNemar's exact test (alpha=0.05) for the confirmatory paired comparison; Brier score and calibration-curve uncertainty bands via bootstrap; for exploratory ablation/subgroup tests control FDR with Benjamini–Hochberg q=0.05.
multiplicity_implementation: Primary confirmatory inference is the paired success-rate difference (no multiplicity correction). All exploratory/ablation/group comparisons are adjusted controlling FDR with Benjamini–Hochberg at q=0.05 as preregistered.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination_plan: compare and hash retrieval/index snapshots (recorded in execution/artifact_hashes) and provider_call manifests; flag any samples where index-hash diverges from preregistered snapshot. Primary analysis excludes flagged contaminated samples; sensitivity analyses include them and report differences. Log count of flagged samples and include flagged-sample cohort results. Residual uncertainty note: hosted LLM nondeterminism documented in provider_call metadata; paired design mitigates but is reported.
